title: Stat 3125 ProjectGuide
text:
This website exists as a resource for STAT 3125 students looking to create a semester project with the intention of presenting at Analytics Day, fulfilling an honors contract, or simply expanding their portfolio.
Resources available on this site include but are not limited to:

Where to find your dataset
Using popular R packages to make data analysis easier
Performing Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
Possible data processing/modeling methods
Using ggplot2 for easy plot creation
Assembling a presentation/poster

If this is your first time using the site, it is recommended to begin by reading our Getting Started page, which will prepare you for your upcoming project.

title: Getting Started
text:
Before a student can get underway with a project, there are a few pieces of prerequisite knowledge that are recommended to prevent roadblocks further down the line.

R and R Studio: The first couple weeks of class will ensure that you are set up with this software, as it is required for classwork. The guides on this website are written with R users in mind.
Popular R packages: These packages will make appearances in some of the example projects on this site and greatly simplify the work of data analysis and visualization.
